snippet.title: Bad Cheese - Release Date Trailer | Steamboat Willie Horror Game
snippet.description:
Bad Cheese is launching on September 1 for PC and ALL CONSOLES (PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2)
🧀WISHLIST NOW: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094480/Bad_Cheese/
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012988

Bad Cheese is a psychological horror game inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation.
